summary: Independent review of PR #310 at 0d4e2ea found application-owned production gaps in database availability and initialization, workload hardening, private-registry pulls, image admission, DNS/monitoring ownership, and cutover documentation.
validation: Controller-materialization review checked all eight PathHelm mappings and rendered companion-resource ownership.
Runtime-security review checked Kata workload paths, admission expressions, registry authentication, and service-account token exposure.
PostgreSQL/operations review checked persistence, disruption behavior, initialization readiness, credentials, and rollback documentation.
Production-operations review checked sync ordering, legacy-owner retirement, DNS continuity, exact-SHA activation, and image immutability.
All reviews targeted exact PR head 0d4e2ea3fac6dc6aba7dce368b49a4134f7a3f58 without cluster access or repository mutation.
Production images were confirmed digest-pinned; no tag-only or dev image was found.
blockers: Single-replica PostgreSQL can be voluntarily evicted, and its readiness probe never checks the initialization marker.
API and initializer security contexts are unenforced; the initializer also receives an unrelated token and can run before prerequisites.
Cleanup and lobby workloads use private Nexus images without rendered image-pull-secret wiring.
Generated-server admission accepts malformed or non-Nexus image references containing only the sha256 substring.
Proxy service accounts unnecessarily automount Kubernetes API tokens.
Public minecraft.codicarium.com DNS is omitted from controller materialization and would be lost when the legacy owner retires.
Proxy metrics sidecar remains enabled while its PodMonitor is explicitly excluded from controller materialization.
Cutover docs omit exact-SHA activation checks and complete PostgreSQL secret lifecycle contracts.
next_action: Return to code; remediate all application-owned findings in lc-config, extend negative and render tests, then rerun the full validation matrix before a new independent review.
independent_lanes: controller resource materialization and ownership continuity
runtime security, registry authentication, and admission
PostgreSQL availability, initialization, and credential scope
production cutover ordering, observability, and documentation

issues.title: Single-replica PostgreSQL PDB permits total voluntary disruption
issues.details: replicaCount 1 with maxUnavailable 1 permits eviction of the only LuckPerms PostgreSQL pod.

issues.title: API and initializer lack enforced pod/container security contexts
issues.details: Empty contexts allow image-default root execution, privilege escalation, capabilities, and non-default seccomp behavior.

issues.title: PostgreSQL readiness never evaluates its initialization marker
issues.details: exec pg_isready replaces the shell before the marker test and can expose an incompletely initialized database as Ready.

issues.title: Database initializer receives unrelated API token secret
issues.details: Shared envFrom exposes orchestrator-api-internal-token to a database-only Job.

issues.title: Initializer hook can run before its service account and secrets
issues.details: The hook runs at wave -5 while embedded prerequisites default to wave 0, so a fresh sync can fail before the Job starts.

issues.title: Cleanup CronJob lacks Nexus image-pull credentials
issues.details: The controller-rendered cleanup Job pulls a private Nexus kubectl image without referencing regcred.

issues.title: Lobby and admin bootstrap lack Nexus image-pull credentials
issues.details: Production and offline lobby workloads render private Nexus images without an ExternalSecret or imagePullSecrets reference.

issues.title: Generated-server image admission accepts malformed references
issues.details: A contains(@sha256:) check does not enforce Nexus repository, tag, or a 64-character lowercase digest for regular, init, and ephemeral containers.

issues.title: Proxy service accounts automount unused Kubernetes API tokens
issues.details: Public and offline proxy pods need no Kubernetes API access but receive default service-account tokens.

issues.title: Controller materialization omits public Minecraft DNS ownership
issues.details: The public DNSEndpoint remains legacy-owned and can disappear when that owner is retired.

issues.title: Controller materialization omits proxy metrics scraping
issues.details: The mc-monitor sidecar remains enabled while PodMonitor is explicitly forbidden from the rendered production profile.

issues.title: PostgreSQL secret lifecycle contracts are undocumented
issues.details: docs/secrets.yaml omits owners, sources, target keys, rotation, and retention behavior for both newly introduced PostgreSQL secret contracts.

issues.title: Controller activation procedure does not enforce the exact reviewed SHA
issues.details: The prepare/activate runbook must verify the grant and descriptor against the exact reviewed commit before legacy-owner retirement.
